title: Search: find offers by a word in the variant
description: Customers search for "GTI", "Business" or "Sport". Adds a `variant` text filter (2 to 120 characters) to the search; it is in filters(), so it is part of the cache key, and matches anywhere in the variant, ignoring case. Tests added.

defects.explanation: The user's text is concatenated into the SQL (addslashes is not a safe escape for every driver or charset) instead of being bound: use whereRaw('lower(vehicles.variant) like ?', ['%'.$variant.'%']).
